# conda-forge specification of the S1-06 user-space environment (Route 1).
# Library versions that the s104 image pins are pinned to the same upstream
# version here; build tooling floats within the stated series and is frozen
# by the exported explicit lock (lock-linux-64.txt). Pinocchio 4.1.0, coal 3.0.3
# and eigenpy 3.13.0 build from their ROS release tags in the workspace, as in
# the image; MuJoCo Python comes from the hash-pinned mujoco-requirements.txt.

# Python run dependencies of the workspace's rosdep keys (launch, controller_manager,
# mujoco_ros2_control, eigenpy). Keys deliberately not provided: test and lint
